claims.claim: Modern-file deletion restoration emits bounded blank-only chunks and keeps a compact reusable source row. Legacy row groups cannot defer blanks across batches. On finish, a trusted writer-version/physical-row count is checked against restored rows; old untrusted metadata retains weaker checks. The new blanks module chooses format/type-aware filler values without defining a new persisted grammar. `rust/lance/src/dataset/updater.rs:314-383,416-460,572-600,759-796`; `rust/lance/src/dataset/updater/blanks.rs:24-65,293-354,458-499`.

Managed-reference helpers now take a caller-supplied Scanner. Clone passes source.scan(); cleanup passes fragment.scan(). The descriptor identity and blob copy/rewrite contract remains unchanged. `rust/lance/src/dataset/blob/clone.rs:227-244`; `rust/lance/src/dataset/cleanup.rs:645-648`.

Updater requires each next() batch to be updated before advancing. finish() rejects an outstanding batch or unread input; its lookahead retains a discovered batch so the caller can continue. Failure during update leaves restoration state unspecified: discard and restart that updater. Do not confuse this with the explicitly recoverable early-finish probe. `rust/lance/src/dataset/updater.rs:183-210,272-289,386-415`.

Built-in pass-through nodes are pure column projections without aliases, non-hash repartition, coalesce and cooperative nodes. A custom node requires explicit certification, one child, unchanged fields, equal cardinality and no fetch; certification additionally promises unchanged values and no stored column indices. Metadata-changing custom nodes are reapplied above take. `rust/lance/src/io/exec/topk_late_materialization.rs:120-132,249-259,264-316,349-379`.

Preprocessed training data now carries TrainingCriteria. The public builder declares value order plus row IDs, and scalar training compares declared versus required criteria, returning InvalidInput on mismatch. It is no longer guarded solely by a BTree-only assertion; canonical bitmap fragment builds still reject preprocessed data. `rust/lance/src/index/create.rs:140-148,436-446`; `rust/lance/src/index/scalar.rs:405-417`; `rust/lance-index-core/src/scalar.rs:494-497`.

Dataset::count_indexed_rows rejects empty index/filter strings; fragment IDs must be unique and current. Supplying physical segment UUIDs requires a nonempty unique list, matching index name, usable scalar details, a keyed field, and nonempty current fragment coverage. `rust/lance/src/dataset/scanner.rs:1440-1556`.

WriterSchema separates caller logical schema, stored field-ID/tombstone/nullable representation, and prepared blob descriptors. Writes are shaped under the same lock as their destination schema. Input names are checked by position and RecordBatch construction validates the logical layout before durable admission. `rust/lance/src/dataset/mem_wal/write.rs:1824-1860,1948-1970,2076-2132`.

The rule declines retained-deletion reads, mismatched dataset URI/version in dropped takes, ineligible reads and limits that keep every row when an upper bound is known. Unsupported shapes retain the original plan with a debug reason. `rust/lance/src/io/exec/topk_late_materialization.rs:163-207,320-345,426-440`.

Base-table alteration rejects primary-key renaming while MemWAL is attached, alongside existing retype/nullability-tightening restrictions. Cached key names make a rename unsafe for writers that have not refreshed. `rust/lance/src/dataset/schema_evolution.rs:491-531,851-874`.

Bitmap cache state now writes bounded lookup batches (32 MiB target, with a larger single key allowed), and its cache codec version is 2. Label-list cache version also becomes 2 because it embeds that state. These are cache-body versions, not a claim that persisted scalar index formats changed to version 2. `rust/lance-index/src/scalar/bitmap.rs:87-90,295-327,362-399`; `rust/lance-index/src/scalar/label_list.rs:892-896`.

Python get_version returns the checked-out version, timestamp and manifest summary without storage reads according to its facade contract; it calls PyO3 current_version, which wraps Dataset::version. Existing versions() shares the timestamp converter. Conversion retains local datetime.fromtimestamp behavior and microsecond precision; it is not a timezone-aware nanosecond timestamp. `python/python/lance/dataset.py:3163-3192,6133-6141`; `python/src/dataset.rs:924-934,2139-2151`.

WAL entries can carry generation metadata, absent in WAL-only mode. Replay can flush a nonempty memtable when an entry advances the generation; entries lacking it retain the size-rule route. This is not a promise that arbitrary older WAL schema changes are reconstructible. `rust/lance/src/dataset/mem_wal/wal.rs:44-62,1117-1125`; `rust/lance/src/dataset/mem_wal/write.rs:1482-1510`.

TakeExec preserves input ordering/equivalences only if input fields are unchanged at the leading output positions. Extending a struct can invalidate that claim; then new equivalence properties are used and maintains_input_order is false. `rust/lance/src/io/exec/take.rs:572-588,604-617,691-695`.

Cleanup deduplicates managed descriptor scans by store/base namespace, fragment serialization, projected fields/IDs and retained state. A OnceCell stores completed scan outcome; per-fragment scans run sequentially within a manifest to bound buffers. Missing expired descriptors may be skipped; retained failures still abort and failed scans are not cached as complete. `rust/lance/src/dataset/cleanup.rs:313-339,594-681`.

Expression coercion recursively applies a column type only to literal-only arithmetic/shift/string-concatenation expressions. Other expressions are left for DataFusion coercion, avoiding premature narrowing of inner-column arithmetic. Upstream implementation is outside scope. `rust/lance-datafusion/src/logical_expr.rs:74-90,128-142`.
Fast search uses row IDs internally but no longer automatically exposes `_rowid` in the output projection. `rust/lance/src/dataset/scanner.rs:2457-2466`.
